title: Free Zone
tagline: A decentralized Social Media Platform in Blockchain that uses  Smart Media Tokens for Social consensus algorithm.
description:
A decentralized Social Media Platform in Blockchain that uses 
Smart Media Tokens for Social consensus algorithm where everyone can 
leverage the power of Freezone for eccentric entrepreneurial cryptocurrency 
projects.
More importantly, it is a social media platform that is guaranteed to save data 
and help users maximize their developments while also ensuring users data 
safety and also a way to make revenue.
how_its_made:
FREEZONE promises to be a special platform with user-friendly features of 
which some are:
 An application with real time analytics and updates which is very adaptable to users requirements. Using the filecoin chain to save interactions.
 A secure platform for eccentric project discussions. With files uploaded to the filecoin decentralised storage technology
 An App designed to help entrepreneurs carry out their pursuits while giving them all the help they can get.
